title: Introduce jitter-aware retry DSL and compact stream compatibility layer; coordinate SDK version bumps
author: Sanjay Patel
description: Motivation: SDKs across Python/TypeScript/Go have diverged slightly in retry semantics and streaming ergonomics which complicates downstream client code and our recommended defaults for production workloads. This PR introduces a small, explicit DSL for retry profiles that encodes jitter/clock-drift-aware backoff windows and a compact compatibility layer for streaming primitives so polyglot clients observe the same resume/close behavior and fewer surprising timeouts. Scope: 1) Add jitter-aware retry profile DSL (name/value mapping, preset loader, and deterministic unit tests). 2) Implement a lightweight stream compatibility adapter in each SDK that normalizes: close order, cancellation propagation, and final chunk detection. 3) Coordinate minor version bumps and lockfile updates: py-sdk->2.3.0, ts-sdk->1.9.0, go-sdk->1.4.1. 4) Backwards-compatible migration helpers and changelog entries. Key changes: - retry: new RetryProfile type with parameters: base_delay_ms, max_delay_ms, jitter_strategy (full|decorrelated|none), max_attempts, retryable_codes. We expose a preset loader that loads recommended profiles from the redwood server or falls back to baked-in presets. - jitter: introduce auth-refresh jitter window (50-500ms) to avoid synchronized token refresh storms during high concurrency. - streaming: CompactStreamCompatAdapter available in all SDKs; introduces a 2-step close handshake (client-close -> graceful drain -> final-ack) and idempotent resume token semantics to prevent duplicated chunks on resume. - ergonomics: small API polishing: Python async iterator gains .close_now() helper; TS exposes withAbortSignal() view; Go adds Context-aware Reader wrapper. Testing: unit tests added for deterministic backoff, simulated concurrent token refresh to assert bounded burst, cross-language integration harness exercised via the existing interop test suite (all green on CI). Migration notes: existing Retry constructors remain supported; to opt into jitter-aware behavior callers must use RetryProfile.load("recommended") or pass jitter_strategy in the constructor. Release impact: non-breaking for typical users; opt-in benefits lower retry storm risk and more predictable streaming resumes. Rollout: rolled to staged canary customers and feature-flagged in hosted for two weeks before global enablement. References: Linear ENG-2103 (retry convergence), SUP-6543 (support case showing duplicated stream chunks).
commits_summary: 4 commits: initial DSL design and tests; python adapter and unit tests; ts adapter + examples + lockfile bump; go adapter + go sdk bump and interop harness updates.
review_comments: Maya Chen: Nice concise DSL. Two asks: 1) add an example showing how a user overrides the preset in the hosted fallback case, 2) can we make jitter window defaults configurable via env var for Dedicated?
Sanjay Patel (author): Added a short example to examples/ and added a DEDICATED_JITTER_MS env hook that the preset loader will read. Updated tests to include env var path.
Elena Rodriguez: Integration harness passes but I observed a flaky TS test on CI intermittently failing around abort-signal timing. Please add an explicit 20ms slack in the harness.
Sanjay Patel (author): Added 20ms slack and a deterministic fake clock in the TS harness. Re-ran CI.
Jonah Lee: API ergonomics look good. One nit: consider naming .close_now() -> .abort_immediate() to make semantics explicit. Not blocking.
Sanjay Patel (author): Kept .close_now() for now to keep parity with other helpers; added docstring clarifying immediate abort semantics and a link to a future API rename RFC.
merge_summary: Merged via squash with message: 'Introduce jitter-aware retry DSL + compact stream compat adapters; bump SDK versions' by Maya Chen. Included coordinated SDK version bumps and updated changelogs. Changelog entries for each SDK were added. No rollback required during canary. Merged to main and tagged for release pipeline.
release_notes: SDKs: Add jitter-aware RetryProfile presets to reduce token-refresh storms and a compact stream compatibility adapter that normalizes resume/cancel semantics across Python/TS/Go. Minor version bumps: python 2.3.0, typescript 1.9.0, go 1.4.1. Migration: opt-in via RetryProfile.load("recommended") or pass jitter_strategy; streaming resumes improved without code changes but enable feature flag to roll out gradually.
